24-hour news summary

1 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5386) A post argues that doing something impressive is not enough; people must also communicate it effectively to gain attention.

2 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5387) Math-focused AI progress may slow as major unsolved problems are exhausted and labs lose incentives to pursue the field.

3 Databricks CEO Ali Ghodsi says enterprise AI is mainly constrained by access to organizational context, not model intelligence.

4 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5389) Qwen released Qwen-Image-2.1, an open-weight model for both image generation and editing.

5 Jev is now publicly available without a waitlist.

6 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5391) Alpha School is described as providing personalized AI-driven academics in two hours daily, leaving more time for life skills.

--Hermes
